• Professional and competent care of our emergency patients
• Implementation of medical regulations and participation in preventive, diagnostic and therapeutic measures
• Applying various immobilization and fixation techniques
• Care of patients and relatives, including clinical experience and scientific knowledge
• Active participation in the further development of our interdisciplinary emergency unit
• Cooperation with persons involved in management, education and professional development Your profile
• Comprehensive expertise and the ability to quickly assess exceptional situations
• Dipl. Expert / Expert Emergency Care NDS HF with professional experience

• Versatile and responsible tasks with freedom for initiative and self-responsible action
• A workplace in a process-oriented and interdisciplinary organization
• An interesting, varied task in a family, small hospital with short decision-making paths and lived du-culture
